extDescription: Hold Alt and drag to select a rectangle – e.g. a single table column – and copy it to the clipboard as text.
siteReload: Reload this page to use the extension here.
hintAltGr: On some keyboard layouts (e.g. Polish, German) Ctrl + Alt is the same as the right Alt key (AltGr). On Windows, Alt + Shift may switch the keyboard layout.
hintPlatform: Mac: Alt is the Option (⌥) key. Linux: if Alt + drag moves the window, choose a different key.
optionsHint: Hold the key and drag with the mouse. In tables whole cells are copied, elsewhere the text inside the rectangle. Esc cancels. If something doesn’t work, reload open tabs.
welcomeLead: Copy exactly the part of a page you need – for example just one column of a table.
step2: Drag with the mouse to draw a rectangle.
step3: Release the button – the selection is already in the clipboard. Paste it anywhere with {1}.
tryHint: Select only the “Price” column in the table below.
tip1: In tables whole cells are copied; outside tables – the text inside the rectangle, line by line.
tip2: Near the edge of the window the page scrolls by itself. Esc cancels the selection.
tip3: The toolbar icon lets you change the key or turn the extension off on a particular site.
tip4: Tip: pin the icon to the toolbar (puzzle icon → pin).
privacy: The extension works only on your computer and sends nothing over the internet.
coffeeNote: Rectangle Copy is free and has no ads. If it saves you time, you can buy me a coffee.
